Here’s the full list of functions you can use:

### Ticketing System Functions
| Function | Parameters | Description |
|----------|------------|-------------|
| `ticket_login` | `{ username: string, password: string }` | Authenticate a user for the ticket system. |
| `ticket_get_login_status` | `{}` | Get the login status of the currently authenticated user. |
| `logout` | `{}` | Log out the current user. |
| `create_ticket` | `{ title: string, description?: string, priority?: number }` | Create a ticket in the system and queue it. |
| `edit_ticket` | `{ ticket_id: number, updates: { title?: string, description?: string, status?: string, priority?: number } }` | Modify the details of an existing ticket. |
| `get_ticket` | `{ ticket_id: number }` | Get a specific ticket by its ID. |
| `get_user_tickets` | `{ status?: string }` | Get all tickets created by the current user, optionally filtered by status. |
| `resolve_ticket` | `{ ticket_id: number, resolution: string }` | Resolve a ticket with a resolution. |
| `close_ticket` | `{ ticket_id: number }` | Close a ticket. |

### Gorilla File System Functions
| Function | Parameters | Description |
|----------|------------|-------------|
| `pwd` | `{}` | Return the current working directory path. |
| `ls` | `{ a?: boolean }` | List the contents of the current directory. |
| `cd` | `{ folder: string }` | Change the current working directory to the specified folder. |
| `mkdir` | `{ dir_name: string }` | Create a new directory in the current directory. |
| `rmdir` | `{ dir_name: string }` | Remove a directory at current directory. |
| `rm` | `{ file_name: string }` | Remove a file or directory. |
| `touch` | `{ file_name: string }` | Create a new file of any extension in the current directory. |
| `cat` | `{ file_name: string }` | Display the contents of a file of any extension from current directory. |
| `echo` | `{ content: string, file_name?: string }` | Write content to a file at current directory or display it in the terminal. |
| `cp` | `{ source: string, destination: string }` | Copy a file or directory from one location to another. |
| `mv` | `{ source: string, destination: string }` | Move a file or directory from one location to another. |
